servinfo.title: Engine Cooling System Inspection
servinfo.ptxt: Before performing the following procedure, observe Precautions for Cooling System:K14D .

s1.ptxt: Check cooling system for leakage or damage.
Check coolant for proper level and freeze protection.
Check cooling system for coolant leakage according to the following procedure.

s2.ptxt: Attach pressure tester (1) to water filler, and then apply specified pressure to cooling system.
Check that cooling system holds the pressure.
If cooling system does not hold applied pressure, check cooling system for coolant leakage.

s1.ptxt: Check degassing tank cap according to the following procedure.

s2.ptxt: Attach pressure tester (1) to degassing tank cap (2), and then apply specified pressure.

spec.title: Degassing tank cap valve opening pressure

s2.ptxt: Check that degassing tank cap releases applied pressure.
If the pressure at which degassing tank cap releases air is higher or lower than specified pressure, replace degassing tank assembly.

s1.ptxt: Detach pressure tester and rinse off spilled coolant.
Install degassing tank cap on degassing tank.
